biggest_catch: The friend must open a 'new qualifying account' - and for loan referrals the friend must mention you and the referring member by name AT the loan closing, or no one gets paid (no exceptions).
catches: Earn $50 for every friend who opens a new qualifying account with WWFCU (no cap stated).
Loan referral: $50 to you AND $50 to the borrower when a referred loan closes; borrower must mention the referral at closing - no exceptions.
Referring member must be a current member in good standing for loan referrals.
Loan credit deposited to savings no later than 5 business days after the new loan closes.
